svg.text: hole: grown-up pokes with a pencil/awl
Calibration: the black bar must measure
exactly 100 mm and the square 20x20 mm.
Use card ~1 mm (cereal box) for parts.
github.com/dev-repos/kids-robotics-projects · Kids.JoinDev · CC BY 4.0 · Grown-ups do all craft-knife cutting.
Lay an ice-cream stick (114x10) on each guide, mark the cut at the red line, grown-up cuts.
Ø3 pin holes 5 mm from the ends (leg stick: also one in the middle). Wiggle the pencil so pins turn freely.
Glue the bottom end of each leg stick across a foot.
GRIP: wrap 2 rubber bands round each foot, or zig-zag
lines of hot glue under it, so it pushes, not slides.
Skewer (3 mm) pieces - snip, true length:
Straw: 4 short rings (3 mm) slide on pin ends as stoppers; glue ring to pin, never to the stick.
